description: `<render of=@phase/>` over an enum whose every variant carries a `renders` clause — the fully-legal shape, shared with the NOT-ENUM and NO-CLAUSE negs so the three codes are isolated against one common control.
rationale: §19.15.3 — `<render of=expr/>` displays an enum value through its variants' `renders` clauses. Without `of=` the element names no subject and selects no variant, so there is no clause to dispatch to.
